I'm the chair of the evaluation committee for the Municipal Water Pipeline Expansion Project (CIB-2024-088). We've just completed the bid opening and I need a formal price score evaluation report before our committee meeting tomorrow.

All the relevant documents are somewhere in the /workspace directory — the tender's price scoring formula, the bid opening record with all five vendors' prices, and the evaluation task instructions from my office.

Please produce a file named price_score_report.json that contains: the parsed structure of the scoring formula, the computed benchmark price, each vendor's price score with the full calculation trace, and an analysis of any boundary risks in the formula.

This is a government procurement evaluation so the numbers need to be exactly right — the committee will scrutinize every decimal.
